title: Nicki Minaj talks about her relationship with Trump: 'I just love him'
text:
Rap superstar Nicki Minaj said her close relationship with President Donald Trump stems from his relatability and sense of humor.

“He’s not just smart, and he’s not just the president, but he’s also just someone I can relate to, someone that, you know, every time I see him, or every time I see him speaking to other people, he’s just himself,” Minaj said on Fox News’s The Ingraham Angle Friday.
